title: Text editors
description:
Time for you to finally set up a _real_ local development environment. Few devs actually codes in their terminal, they just install a IDE which is just a text editor with some QOL stuff and a terminal. This is where VSCode comes in. It is a fairly small text editor and is the most popular with devs today.
A few other good GUI edtiors are:
- [IntelliJ IDEA](https://www.jetbrains.com/idea/)
- [Zed](https://zed.dev)
And some good terminal editors are
- [Emacs](https://www.gnu.org/software/emacs/)
- [Vim](https://www.vim.org)
---
